description: This header file defines the DeviceListHandler class in the cuttlefish namespace. The class handles WebSocket requests related to device lists, using a DeviceRegistry object. It declares constructor and methods for handling GET and POST requests, and includes necessary headers and dependencies.

classes.name: DeviceListHandler
classes.description: A WebSocket handler class for managing device list requests, inheriting from DynHandler.

methods.name: DeviceListHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a WebSocket instance and device registry.

methods.name: DoGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve device list information.

methods.name: DoPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests, possibly to update or modify device list information.
